products.title: Escape Off-Road
products.body_html:
Designed to bring a new look to the 'Mountain Bike Shoe', Escape Off-Road merges die-hard, trail-riding durability with a streamlined, elegant aesthetic. With a glass-fibre reinforced Nylon outsole that delivers stiffness and power on the downward stroke, the shoe prioritises speed and comfort.

Whether gravel grinding, cross-country mountain biking or hitting the local trails, the shoe is perfectly weighted for strength and performance. The reinforced toe guard and resilient, easy-to-clean upper are protective against impact and abrasion, while an innovative TPU tread and integrated spike provides excellent grip on and off the bike.

Eliminating distractions from a full day in the saddle, the shoe provides supportive padding and contoured shaping for impact-resistance and comfort. QUOC's proprietary single dial closure system delivers micro-adjustable precision and stability across the arches of the foot, organic, while well-distributed air ventilation holes aid temperature regulation and breathability.

products.title: QUOC × Lucas Lajoie Bandana
products.body_html:
The QUOC × Lucas Lajoie Bandana is a physical memory of life on the road. Following a 50-day bikepacking journey across Europe where a canvas strapped to his frame gathered road dust, wild berries, and doodles from strangers, artist Lucas Lajoie created LIBRE. That series captured the spirit of unplanned detours and inspired a lasting friendship with QUOC.

To celebrate the World Championships returning to Lucas's adopted home of Montréal for the first time in 52 years, we asked him to paint an exclusive sister piece to the collection. Titled Les Champion(ne)s du Monde à Montréal, the artwork captures his view of the city seen from the saddle of a bike.

Translated here into a versatile lifestyle piece, it is crafted from 100% premium cotton with a remarkably smooth, silky hand-feel. The rich print process captures every texture and brushstroke with vivid clarity, making it as enjoyable folded into a wearable accent as it is rolled out flat or framed on display.

products.title: QUOC x Raer Scent
products.body_html:
Golden Hour is a 100% natural botanical parfum, made with Berlin perfume house Raer. A translation of the Haze Collection and the unique sensation of the last gold hour of a long ride, the scent is rich, warm and distinctively unisex.

At its heart sits Holy Basil — a leaf grown by doorways and carried into temples across Vietnam, the thread that ties this scent back to where Quoc began. The lift of Green Mandarin and Sichuan Pepper gives way to something softer — Pandan Leaf drifting through French Jasmine and Bulgarian Rose. Smoky Alaskan Cedarwood and Patchouli ground the base with a resinous warmth. Eastern botanicals and Western florals, dissolving into one another like landscapes from a moving bike.

Blended by hand in Berlin in small batches, from sustainable rare plants gathered around the world, the scent is free from synthetics and preservatives. Finished with a lid hand-thrown from bisque porcelain in a natural stone made for QUOC, this special edition is limited to 150 bottles.

products.title: Chaos Nalgene Bottle
products.body_html:
QUOC's Chaos Nalgene Bottle pairs the durability of a lab-grade design with original artwork by Vacation Studio, bringing a bold, expressive energy to an everyday essential.

Derived from 50% recycled plastic waste and free of BPA, the bottle features a wide-mouth opening, carry handle, and leak-proof design. Dishwasher safe on the top rack, lightweight at 177g, and produced in the USA, it offers a generous 1L capacity, carrying enough hydration for long days spent in the great outdoors.

products.title: Chaos Tee
products.body_html:
QUOC Chaos Tee in Grey is a heavy-weight tee built for riders who value quality basics. Cut from 240 GSM carded cotton with a garment dye finish, it delivers a rich, lived-in tone that holds its character wash after wash.

The relaxed fit features dropped shoulders and a wide neck ribbing for an easy, contemporary silhouette that sits comfortably over a jersey or worn on its own. Twin stitching and shoulder-to-shoulder tape reinforce the construction, while preshrunk fabric ensures the fit stays true from the first wear.

Small — 51cm body width, 66.5cm body length

Medium — 55cm body width, 70cm body length

Large — 59cm body width, 73.5cm body length

products.title: MAAP x QUOC M3 Pro
products.body_html:
Featuring exclusive performance enhancements including triangular airflow perforations, a TPU-laminated mesh upper and signature etched carbon outsole, this is a road shoe engineered for uncompromising speed. From its unidirectional carbon fiber platform ensuring maximum power transfer to the dual micro-adjustment dial system for perfect fit customization, the M3 Pro perfectly balances racing performance and rider comfort.

The sculpted heel cup and vibration-dampening insole provide secure, fatigue-free support, while MAAP's distinctive colorways and detailing make a bold visual statement. More than just footwear, this collaboration embodies a shared philosophy—where QUOC's technical excellence and MAAP's design innovation unite to redefine speed.

products.title: Motion
products.body_html:
Motion distills QUOC’s high-performance knowhow into a shoe designed for real-world riding. Its revamped single-dial system and updated lace guide positioning ensures an immediately responsive, precision fit, while the high quality PU upper moulds comfortably to the foot’s shape. The shoe prioritises all-day comfort with a slightly roomier last and pressure-relieving tongue design.


Updates like uniformly distributed airholes and extended rubber toe protection make this the most versatile road shoe yet. The carbon-composite sole delivers just enough stiffness for spirited club rides without compromising comfort. Whether logging weekend miles with friends or exploring new roads, Motion proves performance doesn’t require sacrifice — just pure enjoyment of the ride.

products.title: Gran Tourer III
products.body_html:
The Gran Tourer III builds on eight years of gravel expertise, distilling everything learned through previous generations of the Original Gravel Shoe to create the most evolved gravel shoe yet. Designed for riders who seek out adventure on every ride, from epic bikepacking trips to off-piste shortcuts on the daily commute, it provides the perfect blend of performance, comfort and all-terrain adaptability.

A roomy toe-box allows for multi-day comfort, a glass-fibre composite midsole ensures pedalling efficiency and a grippy rubber outsole transitions seamlessly from riding to walking. The QUOC Tech Dial III and jersey-lined collar eliminate pressure points while ensuring a secure fit. QUOC’s signature matte microfibre upper with subtle reflective accents maintains a polished aesthetic on or off the bike.

products.title: SMITH x QUOC Defy Glasses
products.body_html:
A Strata edit of SMITH's Defy sunglasses, finished in Sandstone with subtle Purple Jade and Blue Opal accents — the Capsule's earth-toned palette brought to a bestselling silhouette. At the core of the Defy are large-coverage ChromaPop™ lenses, engineered to enhance natural colour and contrast. They cut through flat light, deepen terrain detail at speed, and reveal the subtle shifts in surface that matter most on gravel.

 The lightweight rimless design removes visual obstruction, while 5-base cylindrical shield curvature wraps the peripheral field for full coverage without the weight. Two-position adjustable Megol nose pads and Megol temple grips hold the frame securely through efforts and descents. AutoLock hinges allow one-handed on and off, and a bonus clear lens with quick-swap interchangeable system adapts from dawn to dusk, open trail to forest singletrack.

products.title: SMITH x QUOC Trace MIPS
products.body_html:
The SMITH x QUOC Trace MIPS® brings the Strata Capsule's language of layered terrain to a helmet engineered for protection across every surface. The Sandstone shell carries a fossilised print with Purple Jade webbing and Blue Opal detailing adding depth and distinction.
 

Complete KOROYD® coverage absorbs energy on impact through thermally welded tubes, while Mips® redirects rotational forces during angled impacts. An integrated skeletal structure creates an internal roll cage for added strength. Eighteen fixed vents with internal air channels maintain airflow during high-output efforts, and SMITH's AirEvac system integrates with performance eyewear for fog-free lenses. The VaporFit dial offers 270-degree fit customisation, while Ionic+® antimicrobial lining manages odour through long days in the saddle.

products.title: SMITH x QUOC Performance Gravel Sock
products.body_html:
An all-new composition crafted exclusively for Strata, combining the best of QUOC's road and gravel sock DNA in a lightweight, breathable build that completes the range. A 68% Coolmax blend with Polyester, Nylon, and Elastic delivers advanced moisture management across all-season gravel riding.
 

 A redesigned anti-slip cuff stays put through the hardest efforts, targeted aeration panels direct airflow where it matters most, and reinforced high-wear zone knitting delivers resilience across all terrains. Available in Sandstone and Purple Jade, completing the Strata kit from the ground up.

products.body_html:

products.title: SMITH x QUOC GTXC Lace
products.body_html:
QUOC's performance gravel shoe reimagined for our Strata Capsule. A Sandstone upper carries a fossilised print, accented by Purple Jade and Blue Opal details. An all-new TPU laminated tongue upgrades comfort and breathability, and the patented double-lock lace system ships with two sets — Sandstone and serrated Purple Jade — for a precise, customisable fit.

Beneath the capsule-exclusive finishes, the best-loved features of the Gran Tourer XC Lace remain: the premium microfibre upper, a carbon-composite outsole with integrated TPU tread, fully recessed SPD cleat compatibility, padded heel cushioning, and three arch inserts for personalised support.

products.title: Signature Merino Sock
products.body_html:
A sock designed for year-round comfort, the Signature Merino Sock blends Australian Merino Wool with Nylon into a single, breathable layer for natural temperature regulation. Improved calf shaping ensures a secure, slip-free fit that holds throughout the ride, while targeted padding at the heel and sole provides ample cushioning and support on high-mileage days.

Reinforced with anti-wear knitting at the ankle, the sock resists the friction and abrasion that comes with extended time in the saddle — delivering lasting quality where it matters most. The Merino blend retains all the natural benefits riders value: thermo-regulation that adapts to changing conditions, anti-bacterial properties and steadfast odour resistance.

products.title: Replacement Dial Closure Set 3.0
products.body_html:
Compatible with Gran Tourer III and Motion models, each set is supplied with recyclable packaging, each set includes two dials and two 70cm wires. Installation requires a flat-head screwdriver.

PLEASE NOTE: Each pack includes one dial for the right shoe, and one dial for the left shoe. If you need to replace both dials on the same shoe, you will need to purchase two replacement dial closure packs.

Please use the instructions detailed on the inside of the packaging. If you need help, please email info@quoc.cc

products.title: Pro Series Sock
products.body_html:
A lightweight pro-level road sock engineered for speed and comfort. The technical blend combines Coolmax with Polyester, Nylon and Elastic for advanced moisture management and a secure, race-ready fit in a single breathable layer.

Designed for high-output road riding, the Pro Series Sock features a redesigned anti-slip cuff that stays put through the hardest efforts, targeted aeration panels for airflow where it matters most, and reinforced high-wear zone knitting for lasting quality across miles. A compression arch provides supportive mid-foot hold, and the overall construction delivers durability without sacrificing the lightweight feel riders demand.

products.title: M Pro Lace
products.body_html:
Born from the pro peloton’s growing preference for lace precision, the M Pro Lace translates the pursuit of the perfect fit to every rider delivering serious effort on the road. The two-tone lacing system delivers even pressure distribution across the foot, creating a locked-in connection that sustains comfort and efficiency from sharp accelerations to all-day efforts.

Sharing its foundation with the acclaimed M3 Pro, every detail is engineered for maximal foot stability, streamlined aerodynamics and effective power transfer. A sculpted heel cup delivers a zero-slip hold, the vibration-absorbing insole cushions against road fatigue, and a breathable mesh-TPU construction offers ventilation without compromising structure. A laminated toe border resists wear — keeping the M Pro Lace pristine and ready to deliver as the ultimate road racing shoe.

products.title: Haze Bottle
products.body_html:
Every ride demands reliable hydration. The Haze Bottle is built with Purist technology — a silica-treated interior that prevents bad tastes, odours, and staining, so your water stays clean from first sip to last. The soft, easy-to-squeeze construction delivers consistent flow at speed, while the high-flow MoFlo cap never leaks and opens and closes cleanly on the move. 

A large opening fits ice cubes or supplement powder with ease. Rinse after each use with warm water and mild soap — do not scrub internal — and dry standing upright, or place on the top rack of a dishwasher. Whether paired with a QUOC shoe or riding alongside the existing range, this is the bottle for completing your setup.

products.title: MAAP X QUOC Gran Tourer XC
products.body_html:
The choice of gravel racers and ultra-adventurers the world over, the MAAP x QUOC Gran Tourer XC - Graphite is the next evolution in an off-road high performance shoe. Born from a groundbreaking collaboration between two leaders in performance and aesthetics, the shoe pairs signature MAAP design cues with QUOC’s expert craftsmanship—engineered to endure, adapt, and exceed the boundaries of every off-grid ride. 

Featuring exclusive details such as a pull tab on the heel, a ribbed TPU tongue and larger ventilation air holes, this is a gravel shoe built with relentless off-road capability. From a stiff carbon composite outsole allowing for excellent power transfer to a TPU tread for unbeatable grip in all conditions, GTXC seamlessly blends performance and comfort. 

A textured microfibre upper and rubber toe cap ensure long-lasting protection, while QUOC Technology Dual Dials delivers micro-accurate tailoring, aided by moulded lace guides for even pressure distribution. Built to conquer technical trails without compromise, the collaboration is more than just a shoe. It’s a statement of shared innovation—where QUOC’s performance-driven design and MAAP’s boundary-pushing style unite.

products.title: Touch Up Stick
products.body_html:
Complementary to QUOC's white cycling shoe range, Dynamic Bike Care Touch-Up rejuvenates leather and synthetic materials, concealing scuffs and stains. The built-in sponge ensures even application, while the hydrating formula prevents cracks. Includes 75ml of restorative solution to maintain shoe a clean and bright aesthetic between rides.

Formulated for QUOC white cycling shoes, Dynamic Bike Care Touch-Up rejuvenates leather and synthetic materials, concealing scuffs and stains while restoring original brightness. 

The built-in sponge ensures even application, and the hydrating formula prevents cracks without compromising flexibility. This 75ml solution targets high-wear areas and stitching discoloration. Regular use maintains shoe appearance and extends material lifespan by protecting against UV fading and deep staining.

products.title: Mono II
products.body_html:
Mono II is a timeless full-carbon road shoe crafted from luxurious, leather-like material and renowned for its minimalist elegance. Featherlight and supremely comfortable, it features a unidirectional carbon sole, a dual dial closure system, and an all-season, two-piece bonded upper.

At the footbed, the shoe utilises a vibration-absorbing insole and a ball-of-foot pressure point release feature, as well as a choice of three arch support options for personalised comfort. Paired with precision dual dials, a supportive padded heel cup, and developed from a hand-worked last that intuitively follows the contours of the foot, Mono II represents the last word in long mile comfort.

Fine details like stylish, brogue-inspired zig-zag stitching and circulation-enhancing tongue trim complete the shoe.

products.title: Chelsea
products.body_html:
Chelsea combines the durable, hard-wearing qualities of a classic work boot with the pedal-efficient performance of a cycling shoe. Whether clipping-in or riding flat-pedal, the boot possesses enough stiffness in the sole for solid power transfer, while maintaining the flexibility, spring, and comfort needed for a full day on your feet.

Ankle-high with a foot-enveloping fit and front and back tabs that facilitate an effortless, pull-on motion, the boot is designed for the get-up-and-go cyclist. Crafted in a high-quality, two-tone suede, it features a low-maintenance, easy-to-clean, waxed front to keep the foot dry through drizzly commutes and puddle-ridden country rides.

The outsole is made from recycled cork-infused rubber, an innovative and sustainable alternative to widely-used EVA. Featuring a gravel tire-inspired lug pattern on the tread, the boot provides excellent traction and grip across mixed-surfaces, from tarmac pavements to off-road scenarios.

products.title: Gran Tourer II
products.body_html:
Designed for and by gravel cyclists, Gran Tourer II takes the popular silhouette of QUOC's best-selling Gran Tourer Lace, and combines it with a stiffer sole and in-house developed dial system technology. With a supple, foot-hugging upper, vibration-absorbing insoles and optimally padded lining, the shoe offers unyielding comfort, evenly distributing pressure and eliminating hotspots on and off the bike.

Adapted for micro-accurate precision adjustment, the intuitive dial system features a one-click quick release, making it easy to get on and off in dynamic ride scenarios. A stiffer, Nylon-composite midsole delivers performance and race-readiness to the shoe while remaining airy and lightweight. In the outsole, QUOC's custom-specced GravelGrip rubber is adapted for excellent grip and walkability, whether you're competing in multi-day, ultra-distance races, or embarking on a leisurely hike-a-bike tour.

Now with a sturdier, quality microfibre, and nature-inspired air holes for maximum ventilation, the shoe features quick-drying ankle padding for all-weather riding. Crafted from a single-piece upper, the understated, modern aesthetic comes complete with pristine edge detailing and QUOC's signature colour border.

products.title: Weekend
products.body_html:
Weekend is a surface-adaptable, all-purpose cycling sneaker, made for your life by bike. Designed for rain or shine, Weekend features a watertight outsole that helps keep your feet dry and comfortable, no matter how many puddles you pass through. And we crafted it with a strengthened mid-board that helps to deliver all of your effort to the pedals, whether you're riding to work, headed on a multi-day adventure, or taking on the MTB trails.

Tailoring to a host of different riders, Weekend delivers performance, grip and comfort to flat-pedal riders, while simultaneously supporting clip-in pedal connectivity for even greater power efficiency via a removable rubber cleat cover.

The outsole is made from recycled cork-infused rubber, an innovative and sustainable alternative to widely-used EVA. Featuring a gravel tyre-inspired lug pattern on the tread, the boot provides excellent traction and grip across mixed-surfaces, from tarmac pavements to off-road scenarios.

products.title: Gravel Shoe Cleats
products.body_html:
Compatible cleats for pairing all QUOC Gravel Shoes with Shimano SPD pedals. The Shimano MTB SPD cleats provide 4° of float for natural foot movement while maintaining secure retention, ideal for mixed-surface riding. Their steel construction ensures durability across gravel and pavement conditions.

Designed specifically for 2-bolt shoe systems, these cleats feature a lateral twist release mechanism that balances easy exit with reliable engagement. The included mounting hardware allows for straightforward installation on QUOC Gravel shoes.

The cleats' low-profile design resists mud accumulation while providing stable footing during hike-a-bike sections. For tension adjustment, consult your pedal's manual as settings vary by model.

products.title: Road Shoe Cleats
products.body_html:
Compatible cleats for quickly pairing all QUOC Road Shoes to Shimano SPD-SL pedals. Shimano SM-SH11 SPD-SL cleats offer a balanced 6° float (3° per side), reducing joint stress while maintaining efficient power transfer. The composite-TPU construction ensures durability, while the 13° release angle facilitates confident disengagement.

Featuring a centered pivot design, these cleats accommodate natural foot movement without compromising pedaling efficiency. The broad cleat platform provides stable walking support and resists debris accumulation. Designed specifically for 3-bolt road shoe systems, they include all necessary mounting hardware for immediate installation.

Note: While straightforward to fit, optimal positioning may benefit from professional bike fitting services. For detailed technical specifications and fitting guidance, consult Shimano's official documentation or an authorized bicycle technician.

products.title: Gran Tourer XC
products.body_html:
The Gran Tourer XC is the ultimate, off-road adventure shoe. Culminating four years of experience and modifications since the release of the original Gran Tourer Gravel Shoe, the brand new XC model delivers flawless performance and incomparable comfort that will see the rider out on the trails with every opportunity they get.

The dual-dial upgrade makes for an entirely hotspot free experience. Delivering custom tailoring and micro-accurate precision, it remains incredibly easy to adjust on the fly and get on and off on technical sections. The combination of the shoe's performance carbon composite outsole with an integrated TPU tread delivers superb stiffness and efficiency, while the addition of a rubber toe cap offers additional durability and protection for the die-hard, all-terrain rider.

Carrying over the Gran Tourer's optimised, padded heel cushioning and foot-moulding insoles while adding a choice of three arch inserts, the new shoe provides the highest possible level of comfort and support. Also carried over from earlier models is the high quality, abrasion resistant microfibre, finished in a choice of traditional and unique collection colours each featuring a continuation of QUOC's signature colour border.

products.title: M3 Sport
products.body_html:
Time for something new. M3 Sport blends QUOC’s signature aesthetics with progressive performance engineering for riders who choose their own path. Built on the racing legacy of the M3 range, this shoe delivers optimal power transfer while maintaining a plush, leather-like PU upper for immediate comfort—no break-in required. 

Designed for the fast and adventurous, M3 Sport features a dual-dial closure system and a wrapped, padded tongue, ensuring a secure yet luxurious fit. Whether pushing hard on breakaway efforts or cruising in style, this shoe is built for those who ride with both speed and expression. The M3 Sport doesn’t just perform—it elevates every ride. 

A wave-print design flows across the upper, adding a subtle yet distinctive flair, while the wrap-fit construction locks the foot in place for maximum efficiency. Ventilation is optimised with airflow channels in the sole and perforations in the upper, keeping feet cool on long rides. Available in White and Chalk colourways, the shoe merges QUOC’s signature elegance with modern detailing. Whether racing, training, or simply riding socially, the M3 Sport is at home where style, comfort, and performance intersect.

Built on the racing legacy of the M3 range, this shoe delivers optimal power transfer while maintaining a plush, leather-like PU upper for immediate comfort—no break-in required.

Designed for the fast and adventurous, M3 Sport features a dual-dial closure system and a wrapped, padded tongue, ensuring a secure yet luxurious fit. Whether pushing hard on breakaway efforts or cruising in style, this shoe is built for those who ride with both speed and expression. The M3 Sport doesn’t just perform—it elevates every ride. 

A wave-print design flows across the upper, adding a subtle yet distinctive flair, while the wrap-fit construction locks the foot in place for maximum efficiency. Ventilation is optimised with airflow channels in the sole and perforations in the upper, keeping feet cool on long rides. Available in White and Chalk colourways, the shoe merges QUOC’s signature elegance with modern detailing. Whether racing, training, or simply riding socially, the M3 Sport is at home where style, comfort, and performance intersect.

products.title: M3 Pro
products.body_html:
Born from relentless innovation and direct collaboration with Tour de France champion Geraint Thomas, the M3 Pro is precision-tuned to eliminate wasted energy. Studying the demands of competitive cycling, this is a road shoe built to endure the body’s most explosive efforts; a high-speed companion that dominates from local crits to WorldTour breakaways.

Every element of the M3 Pro enhances stability and performance. A ribbed, all-season upper material reduces stretch and secures the foot, while a supremely stiff carbon sole maximises power transfer. The direct wrap closure with parallel dual dials ensures comfort and control even at peak effort–ensuring its status as the ultimate road racing shoe. 

A sculpted heel cup provides a supportive hold, preventing heel slip, and the vibration-absorbing insole enhances comfort mile after mile, even on the most punishing days in the saddle. With a new and improved, gloss-finished TPU upper and satin print border, M3 Pro resists wear while remaining easy to maintain—always pristine, always race-ready, always delivering comfort and power in equal measure.

products.title: Gran Tourer XC
products.body_html:
The Gran Tourer XC is the ultimate, off-road adventure shoe. Culminating four years of experience and modifications since the release of the original Gran Tourer Gravel Shoe, the brand new XC model delivers flawless performance and incomparable comfort that will see the rider out on the trails with every opportunity they get.

The dual-dial upgrade makes for an entirely hotspot free experience. Delivering custom tailoring and micro-accurate precision, it remains incredibly easy to adjust on the fly and get on and off on technical sections. The combination of the shoe's performance carbon composite outsole with an integrated TPU tread delivers superb stiffness and efficiency, while the addition of a rubber toe cap offers additional durability and protection for the die-hard, all-terrain rider.

Carrying over the Gran Tourer's optimised, padded heel cushioning and foot-moulding insoles while adding a choice of three arch inserts, the new shoe provides the highest possible level of comfort and support. Also carried over from earlier models is the high quality, abrasion resistant microfibre, finished in a choice of traditional and unique collection colours each featuring a continuation of QUOC's signature colour border.

products.title: All Season Merino Sock
products.body_html: A thinner, lightweight alternative to our thick Merino Tech Wool Sock, the All Season range is a cooling cycling sock suited to all-terrain riding. Made from 60% Australian Merino and 38% nylon, the sock combines comfort-enhancing features in one woven layer, making for a breathable and airy accompaniment to your ride.

products.title: Gran Tourer XC Lace
products.body_html:
The lace closure adaptation of our Gran Tourer XC, combining the flawless performance and incomparable comfort of the now best-selling off-road shoe with a supple and adaptable lace closure. Built for adventure-seekers who prefer a classic style, the tension adjustment and failhard dependability of a lace system is guaranteed to offer an enjoyable riding experience.

As with the dial version, the combination of the shoe’s performance carbon composite carbon composite outsole with an integrated TPU tread delivers superb stiffness and efficiency, while the addition of a rubber toe cap offers additional durability and protection for the die-hard, all-terrain rider.

Carrying over the range's optimised, padded heel cushioning and foot-moulding insoles while adding a choice of three arch inserts, the new shoe continues to provide the highest possible level of comfort and support. The shoe utilises high quality, abrasion resistant microfibre, and is finished in a choice of two brand new colourways along with QUOC's signature colour border.

products.title: QUOC x Restrap Sandal
products.body_html:
The QUOC x Restrap Sandal is a collaboration that unites two British brands with over two decades of footwear innovation and bikepacking experience between them. Handmade in the UK, it exists to bridge comfort and style with functionality and adventure. The QUOC X Restrap Sandal is designed as the ultimate post-ride slip-on; combining casual comfort with minimalist elegance, with a flair of functionality.

The sandal features an anatomically designed footbed, with excellent cushioning and arch shaping. Its grippy anti-slip tread makes it perfectly suited for those relaxed hours after a long day in the saddle, whether it be a woodland campsite, a night in the hammock by the beach or exploring around town.

The extra-thick webbing straps work with QUOC's signature microfibre to fasten over your saddle bag with a locking buckle, allowing for quick and convenient carrying while on a long tour. With Restrap's innovative shaping and bonding, these straps are strong, durable and provide maximum comfort while allowing full adjustability for the perfect fit.

products.title: Winter Overshoe
products.body_html:
QUOC's neoprene Winter Overshoe protects your shoes and feet from the elements in cold and wet conditions no matter what climate you're riding in. Waterproof and windproof, the overshoe is made from premium, rubberised neoprene and features a large reflective logo strip for additional visibility in low light.

With a stretchy, pull-on design and velcro understraps that provide a tailored, firm and unmoving fit over the shoe and leg, the sole is reinforced with a durable material that resists abrasion when walking. With quality, tapered stitching and a seamless cuff for a stylish finish, the Winter Overshoe is the perfect accompaniment to your off-season rides.

products.title: All Season Toe Cover
products.body_html:
Utilising a rubberised, abrasion resistant material, the toe covers are effective against damp, cold, and frost and feature reflective highlights on the sides for additional visibility in low light. The sewn border edging and smooth, tapered shaping makes for a stylish finish.

The cover stretches comfortably over any QUOC road shoe ensuring a firm and unmoving fit, with a cleat opening in the under-attachment crafted to avoid snags and wear from walking. All Season Toe Cover is the perfect accompaniment to your all-season riding.

products.title: M3 Air
products.body_html:
M3 Air is the product of over a decade of research and discovery in performance and innovation. Designed from the feedback and wishlists of some of the most competitive cyclists in the field, a new last matches the comfort and natural fit of its processors while adding increased support at the ball of the foot and space in the toe box to eliminate pressure.

The two-piece upper is built from an incredibly light, foot-moulding TPU. Constructed in multiple layers, it provides natural movement where needed and offers generous mesh panels for maximum aeration in warm and high-intensity conditions. Pairing perfectly with custom neoprene toe cover for comfort for colder weather, the upper is engineered to protect against scuffing, the upper is hardwearing and easy to clean.

Parallel, Dual-Dial Closure lace guides and an upgraded wrap design ensures secure enveloping of the foot for increased stability and an even fit, with none of the structural obstructions created by a tongue. Complemented by a stiff, carbon fibre sole that maximises power transfer, the shoes come with innovative insoles with varying arch supports for comfort through the duration of any pro-level race or limit-pushing pursuit.

products.title: Replacement Dial Closure
products.body_html:
Renew your QUOC shoes with our replacement dial closure set. A crash may ruin your ride, but it doesn't need to ruin your shoes. Easily replace the broken dials and get back out on the bike.

Each set is supplied with recyclable packaging, each set includes two dials, two 70cm wires and a metal tool.

Please note: Each pack includes one dial for the right shoe, and one dial for the left shoe. If you need to replace both dials on the same shoe, you will need to purchase two replacement dial closure packs.

Please use the instructions detailed on the inside of the packaging. If you need help, please email info@quoc.cc

products.title: Extra Fine Merino Tech Wool Sock
products.body_html:
A supremely comfortable cool weather cycling sock ideally suited to bikepacking, all-terrain riding and off-season training, the Tech Wool is made from 57% Australian merino and finished in unassuming green camouflage.

Tailored with a Terry knit compression arch for enhanced comfort, the sock features a unique anti-piling design created by intertwining Nylon yarn with merino wool, building in a lasting quality that holds a better shape and piles less than a 100% wool sock.

Anti-bacterial and steadfastly odour resistant, the Tech Wool benefits from merino wool's well-documented benefits, including its natural thermo-regulation properties that warm or cool as your temperature changes.

products.title: All Road Sock
products.body_html: Designed in unique, seasonal colourways for individual rider expression, the All Road Sock features a soft-feel Cotton/Nylon mix and ribbed ankle detailing for comfort and style. Thick enough for colder seasons, the sock is light on the skin with optimal stretch and durability, and features a dimpled mesh for breathability. Compliments any ride, from gravel adventures to commutes and relaxed cycling.

products.title: Escape & Motion Road Replacement Heel Pads
products.body_html:
Renew your QUOC Escape & Motion road shoes with our replacement individually-sized heel pad set. We all love coffee rides but walking to and from the counter quickly wears out your heels pads. Prolong the life of your road shoes with our easily replaceable and hard-wearing heel pads.

Supplied with recyclable packaging, each set includes two pads and two screws. Take out the insole and use a cross-head screwdriver to remove the old set and replace with the new pads.

products.title: Escape Off-Road
products.body_html:
Designed to bring a new look to the 'Mountain Bike Shoe', Escape Off-Road merges die-hard, trail-riding durability with a streamlined, elegant aesthetic. With a glass-fibre reinforced Nylon outsole that delivers stiffness and power on the downward stroke, the shoe prioritises speed and comfort.

Whether gravel grinding, cross-country mountain biking or hitting the local trails, the shoe is perfectly weighted for strength and performance. The reinforced toe guard and resilient, easy-to-clean upper are protective against impact and abrasion, while an innovative TPU tread and integrated spike provides excellent grip on and off the bike.

Eliminating distractions from a full day in the saddle, the shoe provides supportive padding and contoured shaping for impact-resistance and comfort. QUOC's proprietary single dial closure system delivers micro-adjustable precision and stability across the arches of the foot, organic, while well-distributed air ventilation holes aid temperature regulation and breathability.

products.title: Lala Slide
products.body_html:
The Lala Slide is designed as the ultimate post-ride slip-on; combining casual comfort with minimalist elegance, while offering more purpose and utility than your generic flip-flop or shower slide.

Providing regenerative support during rest days, the Lala Slide features an anatomically designed footbed, with excellent cushioning and arch shaping. Its grippy, anti-slip tread makes it as adapted to the velodrome shower room as it is a shrubby woodland campsite.

The extra-thick dual straps utilise QUOC's premium signature microfibre, borrowed from the award-winning Gran Tourers. With leather-like properties, they provide support and comfort with excellent weatherproofing. The aeration footbed design cools the feet, ensuring maximum breathability on long tours.

products.title: Gran Tourer Lace
products.body_html:
From fireside to fire trails, the Gran Tourer Bike Shoe is designed for all-terrain cyclists looking to hit trails and tarmac during the same ride. Made to meet the challenges of mixed-surface riding, the Gran Tourer is equally able to pedal a Great Divide as it is crest cols and take the rocky road home.

Delivering all-day comfort and weather protection in a classic silhouette, the Gran Tourer has a unique rubber outsole that blends long-term durability with superb off-bike underfoot grip when fallen trees (and cafe stops) have you walking for a spell.

Protected from water ingress from the recessed SPD cleat area to the top of the abrasion-resistant upper, a water-resistant gusseted tongue helps keep tyre spray and rain from penetrating the shoe's upper. A favourite among those who value style as highly as performance, the lace system allows for reliability on long rides and offers even pressure distribution across the top of the foot.

products.title: Gran Tourer II
products.body_html:
Designed for and by gravel cyclists, Gran Tourer II takes the popular silhouette of QUOC's best-selling Gran Tourer Lace, and combines it with a stiffer sole and in-house developed dial system technology. With a supple, foot-hugging upper, vibration-absorbing insoles and optimally padded lining, the shoe offers unyielding comfort, evenly distributing pressure and eliminating hotspots on and off the bike.

Adapted for micro-accurate precision adjustment, the intuitive dial system features a one-click quick release, making it easy to get on and off in dynamic ride scenarios. A stiffer, Nylon-composite midsole delivers performance and race-readiness to the shoe while remaining airy and lightweight. In the outsole, QUOC's custom-specced GravelGrip rubber is adapted for excellent grip and walkability, whether you're competing in multi-day, ultra-distance races, or embarking on a leisurely hike-a-bike tour.

Now with a sturdier, quality microfibre, and nature-inspired air holes for maximum ventilation, the shoe features quick-drying ankle padding for all-weather riding. Crafted from a single-piece upper, the understated, modern aesthetic comes complete with pristine edge detailing and QUOC's signature colour border.

products.body_html: Supplied with recyclable packaging, each set includes two pads and two screws. Take out the insole and use a cross-head screwdriver to remove the old set and replace with the new pads.

products.title: Mono II
products.body_html:
Mono II is a timeless full-carbon road shoe crafted from luxurious, leather-like material and renowned for its minimalist elegance. Featherlight and supremely comfortable, it features a unidirectional carbon sole, a dual dial closure system, and an all-season, two-piece bonded upper.

At the footbed, the shoe utilises a vibration-absorbing insole and a ball-of-foot pressure point release feature, as well as a choice of three arch support options for personalised comfort. Paired with precision dual dials, a supportive padded heel cup, and developed from a hand-worked last that intuitively follows the contours of the foot, Mono II represents the last word in long mile comfort.

Fine details like stylish, brogue-inspired zig-zag stitching and circulation-enhancing tongue trim complete the shoe.

products.title: Performance Road Sock
products.body_html:
The Performance Road sock is a soft and supportive road racing sock, built for speed, style and enduring comfort.

Tailored tall, the socks wick quickly with a refreshing Coolmax/Nylon fabric blend that draws moisture from the foot to deliver consistent comfort across the sole and upper.

Throughout the socks, a supportive mid-arch, heel area and engineered toe-box trimmed with pink stitching meet the demands of daily wear. A tone-to-tone QUOC logo faces the rear, completing a light upper styled to reflect the dimpled Aerofoil exterior of the Mono road cycling shoe.

products.title: Extra Fine Merino Tech Wool Sock
products.body_html:
A supremely comfortable cool weather cycling sock ideally suited to bikepacking, all-terrain riding and off-season training, the Tech Wool is made from 57% Australian merino and finished in unassuming green camouflage.

Tailored with a Terry knit compression arch for enhanced comfort, the sock features a unique anti-piling design created by intertwining Nylon yarn with merino wool, building in a lasting quality that holds a better shape and piles less than a 100% wool sock.

Anti-bacterial and steadfastly odour resistant, the Tech Wool benefits from merino wool's well-documented benefits, including its natural thermo-regulation properties that warm or cool as your temperature changes.

products.title: Gran Tourer Lace
products.body_html:
From fireside to fire trails, the Gran Tourer Bike Shoe is designed for all-terrain cyclists looking to hit trails and tarmac during the same ride. Made to meet the challenges of mixed-surface riding, the Gran Tourer is equally able to pedal a Great Divide as it is crest cols and take the rocky road home.

Delivering all-day comfort and weather protection in a classic silhouette, the Gran Tourer has a unique rubber outsole that blends long-term durability with superb off-bike underfoot grip when fallen trees (and cafe stops) have you walking for a spell.

Protected from water ingress from the recessed SPD cleat area to the top of the abrasion-resistant upper, a water-resistant gusseted tongue helps keep tyre spray and rain from penetrating the shoe's upper. A favourite among those who value style as highly as performance, the lace system allows for reliability on long rides and offers even pressure distribution across the top of the foot.
